text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I thought I gave it my all for this day, 
but I still couldn't catch up...
choice_data_list:
Let's make all our hard work up to now 
count for what's next!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's true that I lost, but... I gave it 
everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The only other thing I need is the ability 
to take 1st place. I'm going to work 
harder and harder...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's enough moping around! There's 
always next time!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, we have to do our best 
in training, don't we...!"
